6652.title: Plugin-owned skill icons bypass registered branding
6652.rootCauseOneLine: Null-provider skill icon selection ignores plugin identity and registered branding in the collection, header, and Included tooltip.
6652.proposedFix: Resolve plugin-scoped skill icons through existing plugin branding while retaining bb and provider fallbacks.
6652.caveats: Reproduced twice with real React components and synthetic branding; not a packaged macOS plugin-install check. Full reproduction test is inline in the report.
